files.content:
---
/**
 * @title Input
 * @level liftoff
 * @description Themed text input built atop OriginInput with semantic token styling.
 * @category Forms
 * @hydration none
 * @accessibility
 * - Delegates label binding, persistent hints and native constraints to `OriginInput`.
 * @keyboard
 * - Native input keyboard behavior.
 */

import OriginInput from "@lsui/origin/Input.astro";
import type { ComponentProps } from "astro/types";
import "./core.css";

type Props = ComponentProps<typeof OriginInput>;

---

<OriginInput {...Astro.props} />
